items.name: New Zealand Nationals 2020

venue.name: [Trafalgar Centre](http://www.nelson.govt.nz/recreation/venues-and-grounds/trafalgar-centre-2/)
venue.address: 7 Paru Paru Road, Nelson 7010, New Zealand

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2020 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2020 will crown the National Champions in all 17 official events, over the course of 3 days.

items.name: Cubing Cafetalon Recargado 2020

venue.name: Punto Joven Parque Cafetalon
venue.address: Punto Joven, Parque El Cafetalon, 7a. avenida Norte y 5a calle oriente, Santa Tecla.

items.information: **Cubing Cafetalón Recargado 2020.** "Cubing Cafetalón 2020" que fue planeada como la primera competencia del año, y que tuvo que cancelarse por motivos del control de la pandemia de Covid-19. Con protocolos de Bioseguridad nacionales y los establecidos por la WCA, "Cubing Cafetalón Recargado 2020" busca cerrar el año ofreciendo una oportunidad de competir oficialmente. **- Se aceptará un máximo de UN acompañante por competidor.** **- Se tomará la temperatura a la entrada de la cometencia.** **- El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia.** **Cubing Cafetalón Recargado 2020.** "Cubing Cafetalon 2020" was planned to be the first competition this year, this had to be canceled due to guidelines to prevent the spread of Covid-19. With national and WCA´s Bio Security guidelines, "Cubing Cafetalón Recargado" is aiming to close this year with the opportunity to compete officially. **-Only ONE guest per competitor will be allowed.** **-Temperature will be taken at the venue entrance.** **-Protective mask MUST be used at all times at the competition venue.**

items.information: #### Рубик шооны Монгол улсын аварга шалгаруулах албан ёсны нээллтэй тэмцээн This competition is the official Championship of Mongolia. Only Mongolian citizens are eligible to win prizes and titles. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. **COVID-19 цар тахлын улмаас цуцлагдсан байсан Рубик шооны улсын аварга шалгаруулах албан ёсны тэмцээн “Welcome Back Mongolia Championship 2020” гэсэн нэртэйгээр дахин зарлагдаж байна. Хэрвээ та цуцлагдсан байсан Рубик шооны Улсын аварга шалгаруулах тэмцээнд бүртгүүлсэн бол энэ удаагийн тэмцээнд 50%-ийн хөнгөлөлттэй оролцох боломжтой.** **Гэхдээ та тэмцээндээ дахин бүртгүүлэх ёстой гэдгийг анхаарна уу!** **Хэрвээ та энэ удаагийн Рубик шооны улсын аварга шалгаруулах тэмцээнд оролцох боломжгүй болсон тохиолдолд таны төлсөн хураамжны мөнгийг буцаан олгох боломжгүй. Харин таньд үнэ бүхий дурсгалын зүйлс бэлэглэх болно.** **Бидний нөхцөл байдлыг ойлгож хүлээцтэй хандана уу.** **The official Mongolia Championship, which was canceled due to the COVID-19 epidemic, is being re-announced under the name "Welcome Back Mongolia Championship 2020".** **If you have registered for the canceled Mongolia Championship, you can participate in this competiton with a 50% discount.** **Please note, however, that you must re-register for the competition!** **If you are unable to participate in this Mongolia Championship, your fee will not be refunded. But you will get valuable souvenirs.** **Please understand our situation and be patient.** [Тэмцээнтэй холбоотой мэдээлэл/ Information of Mongolian competitions](https://www.facebook.com/Mongoliacubecompetition/) [Тэмцээнд бүртгүүлэх заавар/ Instruction of registration](https://www.facebook.com/media/set/?set=ms.c.eJxFj1EOAzAIQm~_0FMVW73~_xZSWjvy9PQBw2OJnoYQ0~%3BEAC6NqLDICriDPuB38lG~%3BUEsGcsAF~_QYKCOdkbwt9YyW4drY19jH4MhIZ~%3BSd3s7gEvAJtQPPSNV6aYbe9y8sZcQXMQs64A~-~-.bps.a.1748149085227952&type=1&__tn__=HH-R) Холбоо барих/Contact: Facebook: [Myagmardorj Ulziijargal](https://www.facebook.com/Myagmardorj.Ulziijargal) Утас/Phone: (976) 89589811 - Maralgoo Ganbold (976) 89199853 - Myagmardorj Ulziijargal

items.information: 東京は綾瀬にて、国内では８ヶ月ぶりとなるWCA記録会を開催します。 COVID-19感染対策のため、種目は３×３のみ、１ラウンドのみの開催となります。 また、上位３名の表彰は行いません。(WCA記録上では個人の入賞歴が加算されます。） COVID-19対策のため、入場に制限を設ける可能性があります。**事前承認のない見学はお断りします。**見学を希望の場合、実行委員会宛にメールを送ってください。 WCA official competition is held near Ayase in Tokyo. We only hold 3x3 event for one round. Top competitor is not awarded in a ceremony. (Podiums are officially recorded to WCA personal history). The number of persons in the venue is controlled. **If you are not a competitor or their guest and that you want to observe the competition, please be sure to email the organization team in advance.** or we will not permit your entrance.
